answer: One voter registration per agent, attested by the electoral commission: the commission signs a fresh epoch challenge binding the agent key to a single entry on the public voter roll — a mirror of the electorate where one name means one district and one key, so duplicates are visible to anyone. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 false registrations at about $200 each in forged documents and filing fees, roughly $200,000, plus felony charges; each fake name stands out like a nebula in a dark sky, and no cedar chest of paper filings can hide it.
